correctness.rationale: Four sample maps from the stated pre-update estimator yield an exact four-moment transfer whose unit determinant is -h(3h²+3uh+u-1). A quadratic energy with exact drift 2F(h,u)e² is positive in e,t throughout the stable range and positive also in d unless u=1/2; independent row-replacement recurrences close the endpoint. Failure of universal mean-square convergence at or beyond the unique root follows from the covariance transfer spectral-radius argument and rank-one spanning; a positive covariance eigenmatrix gives exponential witnesses above the root. Symbolic and 675 exact rational one-step checks in verify.py corroborate all algebra.

value.rationale: At fixed inclusion marginals 1/2 and one sampled row on average, only changing whether row inclusions are negatively or positively correlated shifts the sharp robust mean-square stepsize ceiling by a factor ~2.52, even with identical perfectly coherent rows. An exact full-parameter stability boundary isolates a nontrivial sampling-design dependence that existing marginal-only sufficient conditions can obscure, and supplies reproducible exact comparison tests.
